# Advanced statistics report (synthetic data)

*Generated by `06_india_advanced_statistics/src/analyze.py`, seed 2026. Synthetic data: methods demonstration only.*

## A/B test
- Control 2.716% (n=9,941) vs treatment 3.161% (n=10,059); absolute lift +0.445 pp.
- Newcombe 95% CI for the difference: [-0.023, +0.915] pp. z-test p = 0.0623; permutation p = 0.0626.
- Bayesian (uniform prior): P(treatment better) = 96.9%; 95% credible interval for relative lift [-0.8%, +36.6%].
- Power: at this sample size the smallest lift detectable with 80% power is about 0.68 pp; observed power for the observed lift is 46%.
  Detecting a 20% relative lift would need about 15,388 users per group.
- Channel tests: 0 of 4 significant before correction, 0 after Holm correction.

## E-commerce
- Late deliveries carry a lower review score: Cliff's delta = -0.75; bootstrap 95% CI for the mean review gap (on-time minus late) [+1.41, +1.48] stars.
- In the robust OLS, `late` coefficient = -1.432 stars (HC3 p < 0.001), holding shipping days, category, payment method and order value fixed.
- Odds ratio of a low (<=2) review for late deliveries = 41.15.
- See `outputs/ecommerce_hypothesis_tests.csv` for all tests with effect sizes.

## Caveats
Statistical significance is not business value. Because every dataset here is simulated, the generating
assumptions drive the results; use these scripts as templates for first-party data.
